label: B25-BRINGUP-BATCH
implementation: clk_u59=100 MHz is divided by four to a real 25 MHz logic clock; Qsys auxiliary 100 MHz and EMIF 266.667 MHz domains are preserved.
A 64 KiB initialized BRAM boots at PC=0 with stack [0xF000,0x10000); the same ELF produces byte HEX and WIDTH=64 DEPTH=8192 MIF.
The BRAM-resident monitor emits four startup lines and supports p/PONG, status, DDR retest and printable echo through polling JTAG-UART addr[2].
MMU-off DDR is uncached for deterministic bring-up; the AXI line bridge returns offset0 from beat0 and serves offsets1..7 exactly once.
The AXI4-to-Avalon adapter returns bounded DECERR on in-flight calibration failure, EMIF-only reset and backend timeout, holds B/R under backpressure and drains/poisons late read epochs.
T-045 CDC synchronizers and QSF-relative generated MIF are explicitly represented in SDC/checkers/manifests.
